message.title: Message from the principal
message.subtitle: Leadership Note
paragraphs: Welcome to Purandhara Everest Academy. Since our inception in 2064 BS, we have been committed to providing an environment where every student can achieve their full potential.

We don't just teach subjects; we nurture leadership, compassion, and resilience. Our dedicated faculty and modern infrastructure are here to ensure that your child is prepared for the global stage while staying connected to our local values.
